title: Dragon Catalyst Reaction Chamber
description: The user operates a mystical alchemical reaction chamber where a crystalline dragon serves as a living catalyst suspended in volumetric light beams. Players must adjust reagent concentrations, beam intensity, temperature, and pressure across multiple steps to trigger a successful transmutation reaction, watching the dragon's attenuation properties change color as chemical equilibrium shifts.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with es-module-shims) implementing an interactive alchemical reaction chamber. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: place godrays_demo as the background environment representing volumetric energy beams filling the chamber, and load DragonAttenuation as a crystalline dragon catalyst floating at center, slowly rotating. Use PerspectiveCamera at position (0,2,5) looking at origin with OrbitControls limited to 60-degree polar range. Add ambient light (0.3 intensity) plus a DirectionalLight and a PointLight near the dragon. Create an HTML overlay panel with these interactive controls requiring 7 sequential steps with validation: (1) A dropdown to select 'Base Reagent' from Sulfur/Mercury/Salt — must pick Mercury to proceed. (2) A slider for 'Beam Wavelength' (380-780nm) displayed with color preview — must be in range 490-560nm (green spectrum). (3) A number input for 'Chamber Pressure' (1-100 atm) — must be between 25-50 atm. (4) A slider for 'Temperature' (200-2000K) — must be 800-1200K range. (5) A dropdown for 'Catalyst Activation Mode' choosing Alpha/Beta/Gamma — must select Gamma. (6) A slider for 'Reagent Concentration' (0.1-5.0 mol/L) — must be 1.5-2.5 mol/L. (7) A final 'Initiate Transmutation' button that validates all parameters, shows red error glow on invalid fields, and on success triggers an animation: the dragon model scales up 20%, its material emissive color shifts from blue to gold over 2 seconds using TWEEN or manual lerp, the godrays model increases emissive intensity, and particle effects (BufferGeometry points) spiral around the dragon. Display a status bar showing 'Reaction Progress' that fills to 100%. Each valid parameter step should light up a green indicator dot. Use MeshPhysicalMaterial properties on the dragon to animate transmission and attenuation color. Style the UI panel with dark semi-transparent background, gold accent borders, and alchemical-themed fonts.
